sn23.10:1.2: nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Rādham Bhagavā etad avoca || || 4
sn23.10:1.3: Rūpe kho Rādha yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭānābhinivesānusayā te pajahatha ||
sn23.10:1.4: evan taṃ rūpam pahīnam bhavissati ucchinnamūlam tālāvatthukatam anabhāvakataṃ āyatim anuppādadhammaṃ || || 5
sn23.10:1.5: Vedanāya yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā tanhā ye upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā te pajahatha ||
sn23.10:1.6: evaṃ sā vedanā pahīnā bhavissati ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā || pa || āyatim anuppādadhammā || || 6-7
sn23.10:1.8: Saṅkhāresu yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ya upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā te pajahatha ||
sn23.10:1.9: evante saṅkhārā pahīnā bhavissanti ucchinnamūlā || pa || āyatim anuppādadhammā || || 8
sn23.10:1.10: Viññāṇe yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā te pajahatha ||
sn23.10:1.11: evantaṃ viññāṇam pahīnam bhavissati ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukatam anabhāvakatam āyatim anuppādadhamman ti || ||
sn23.10:2.4: Chandarāgā apare duve ti || || 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ
